citations.quote: Clients Are Panicking. What Agent should Do

patterns.observation: The title presents a situation followed by a call to action, 'Clients Are Panicking. What Agent should Do'.

proposed_adaptation.action: Use a situation-action format in titles to clearly present a problem and the ensuing discussion or solution.
proposed_adaptation.limits: Only observed in LinkedIn, single example.
proposed_adaptation.when: When crafting titles to catch attention on professional networks.

patterns.qualification: Single authored post; unclear if a common technique.
patterns.situation: A post addressing a specific audience with a call to action in the title.

citations.quote: I was actually planning to write this for years! Because I’ve been approached literally every day by one or another startup.

patterns.observation: The author shares personal experiences of being approached by startups and situates these within a broader narrative about market trends since 2022.

proposed_adaptation.action: Incorporate personal narrative to enhance relatability and context in discussing broader trends.
proposed_adaptation.limits: Observational; not all industries allow the same level of personal storytelling without breaching confidentiality.
proposed_adaptation.when: Sharing expert insights or advice related to industry trends.

patterns.qualification: Based on self-reported experience; narrative context may affect accuracy.
patterns.situation: The author narrates their experience interacting with startups and discusses broader trends.

citations.quote: But for everyone else, maybe it’s time to rethink where you’re putting your investment…

patterns.observation: The author's advice is direct and uses imperative forms to advise rethinking investment strategies.

proposed_adaptation.action: Use direct, imperative forms to convey advice clearly and assertively.
proposed_adaptation.limits: Single-post observation; effectiveness across different audiences or platforms is not validated.
proposed_adaptation.when: Providing targeted advice to an audience with specific professional roles.

patterns.qualification: Authored tone in a single post; not a universal style.
patterns.situation: Providing advice to a specific audience through a professional platform.
